scope: Independent linear oscillator, tributary-area scaling and sphere-cap damping analysis; no DEM solver or inferred benchmark mass allocation
gates: Closed underdamped restitution agrees with independent solve_ivp endpoint within 1e-10
Full body mass at every node grows aggregate damping as sqrt(node_count)
Area-partitioned mass gives invariant full-patch damping, without asserting it is the source prescription
Partial contact changes the effective linear restitution
Fixed traction viscosity gives cap tangent damping ratio proportional to sqrt(depth)
limitations: No validation of thesis sign convention or ambiguous printed logarithm
No nonattractive clipping or nonlinear impact restitution prediction
Not benchmark reproduction or material admission
